Of course! Based on the policy file we reviewed earlier, here are the **exchange rules and limitations**:

---

### Exchange Policy for Delivered Orders

#### Eligibility
- The order **must have a status of "delivered"** — you should verify this before requesting an exchange.
- Exchange can only be called **once per order** — so all items to be exchanged must be collected into a single request.

#### What Can Be Exchanged
- Each item can be exchanged for a **different variant/option of the same product type** (e.g., a different color or size of the same mouse).
- You **cannot** change product types (e.g., swap a mouse for a speaker).

#### Payment
- You must provide a **payment method** to pay or receive a refund for any **price difference** between the old and new items.
- If using a **gift card**, it must have enough balance to cover any price difference.

#### Confirmation
- The agent must list all action details and get your **explicit confirmation (yes)** before proceeding.
- You will be **reminded to confirm you've provided all items** you want to exchange, since this action can only be done once.

#### After Exchange
- The order status changes to **"exchange requested"**.
- You'll receive an **email** with instructions on how to return the original item(s).
- **No need to place a new order** — the exchange handles it.

---

### Key Takeaways ⚠️

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| **One-time only** | Exchange can only be done once per order — make sure all items are included. |
| **Same product type** | Items can only be swapped for different options of the same product (not a different product). |
| **Price difference** | You'll pay or be refunded the difference via a payment method you provide. |
| **Delivered orders only** | Pending, processed, or cancelled orders are not eligible. |

---

Would you like to proceed with an exchange on one of your delivered orders, or do you have any other questions about the policy?
